_comment: THE BLOG PLAN. The topic clusters, each one pointed at the page that earns money or support. Every planned post names `proof`: the first hand thing only Jordan has (a tool he built, a number he measured, a client job, a show). A post with no proof is not written, because a post that only summarises what already ranks is exactly what Google's scaled content policy removes. Search volumes are NOT here on purpose: nothing on this Mac has measured them, and a guessed number would be quoted as a fact. Measure in Search Console once the site has a few weeks of impressions, then reorder.
cadence: One post a week, at most two. Depth over count: ten posts that each answer one question fully beat fifty that skim.
